prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a shop with a hanging sign (no letters, just an icon) in a snow-buried northern village. Snow-covered steep roof. Dark log walls with snow drifts against them, small warm windows. Windows glow warm amber from inside (the only light). The whole image is 208 x 192 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Edit the attached layout guide into ONE isolated northern-village shop sprite. Treat the attached image as an EXACT pixel-coordinate template, not merely a suggestion. Output transparent PNG, 208×192 ART pixels, shown at 7× nearest-neighbor enlargement if output image is enlarged (reference is 1456×1344). All edges and details on integer art-pixel grid, crisp equal-sized squares, zero anti-aliasing. Background magenta is transparency: absolutely no magenta showing. Preserve precise outer building silhouette: upper roof block x=2..205, y=28..133; narrower lower straight-on wall x=8..199, y=134..191; preserve existing dark horizontal roof detail line at y=75. Keep the snow-covered steep roof a 3/4 JRPG overhead-view ROOF shown from above in that upper block, never turn it into a frontal triangular house facade or perspective isometric building. Keep front wall in lower block straight-on. Keep windows EXACT same locations and sizes x=42..57 and x=148..163, y=160..179, with their dark outlines and small amber lit interiors. Keep DOOR at x=109..130, y=160..191, as an unobstructed walk-through-height dark brown rectangle reaching the building's bottom edge, same size, no stairs or snow across it. Transform surfaces into richly hand-pixeled premium hi-bit 2D JRPG pixel art: snow-loaded slate roof with nuanced blue lavender/mauve shadow and creamy yellow-white highlights, uneven but neatly shaped snow bands following roof's existing long seam; dark horizontally stacked timber-log front walls with visible joins, reddish purple shadow tones, subtle warm worn timber highlights; small amber-glowing windows (the ONLY light), subtle snowdrifts at base away from doorway, restrained snow on eaves, wood shop door. Add a tiny hanging shop sign on a short side bracket with an ICON ONLY (e.g. mitten), no letters, positioned so as not to cover either window or the door, optionally one tiny chimney above roof in empty top margin. Earthy richly hue-shifted palettes, 4–6 flat colors per material, clear hand-placed pixel clusters of 3–10 pixels. Calm even neutral soft upper-left overcast base light, no cast shadows, no pools of light, no vignette, not a nighttime scene. NO ground, shadows outside silhouette, sky, humans, text, words, letters, blur, gradient, textured noise, checkerboard dithering, or subpixel lines. Strict transparent background.
